runs.question: What fine does OMB M-25-21 set for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-21 doesn't set any fine for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline. The passages I found don't mention a penalty for missing it.

The memo does set the deadline and the requirement. Within 180 days of the memo's issuance, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to responsible AI use and for achieving enterprise-wide improvements in the maturity of their applications. Agencies must use the AI Strategies template that OMB will provide, and they must make their strategies publicly available. The requirement applies to CFO Act agencies except the Department of Defense, and it does not apply to elements of the Intelligence Community.

My search was limited to passages about the strategy deadline and penalties. I didn't read the whole memo, so I can't rule out a penalty elsewhere in it. I found nothing suggesting one.
